subject: Q4 2025 Investor Update — Test Deal
preheader: Occupancy up, NOI ahead of budget, and what's next for the project.

blocks.title: A strong finish to the year
blocks.subtitle: Test Deal delivered ahead of plan this quarter. Here's where things stand and what comes next.

blocks.heading: Dear Partners,
paragraphs: We are pleased to share this update. The period delivered strong operational results, and we remain on track with our business plan.
Below you'll find the headline numbers, progress on site and our outlook for the coming quarter. As always, your full statements and documents are in the F1 Portal.

blocks.title: Leasing momentum carried into Q4
blocks.text: New leases outpaced move-outs every month this quarter, and renewals came in above our underwriting.

blocks.title: Unit upgrades on time and on budget
blocks.text: The interior upgrade program is 60% complete, with upgraded units leasing at a premium to the rest of the property.
Our focus for next quarter is simple: keep execution tight and keep you informed every step of the way.
blocks.author: GABE MONTICURE, FOUNDER

blocks.title: Questions about your investment?
blocks.text: Book a call with the Forma One team or sign in to see your statements and documents.
